sourceCause.law: Installed-package content-mapper modules import the checker-only `vize/virtual-ts-checker` entry in place of `vize/virtual-ts` (#11591). The import grows by 8 bytes; every generated coordinate after it, in text map comments, mappings, directive rows and semantic links, moves by exactly 8. Authored coordinates and every other field are unchanged.
